Name: Kenneth's Arcane Decanters
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Arcane Decanters[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]48 arcane decanters for Kenneth's Potion Shop. Decanters, philters, and tinctures in deep, dark, and golden looks.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]48 potions in Shop4, all with that fancy decanter feel. Some are bright and fizzy, some are dark and quiet, and a few are the kind you save for a long day. Decanters, philters, tinctures, elixirs, and flasks are in there, in crimson, azure, gold, and midnight looks.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check Shop4 in game when you have time, and see which one fits how you play.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Potion Shop - Shop4[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You buy with gold, no bars or gems needed.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Go to Kenneth's Potion Shop, Shop4.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Take a look at what is for sale.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Buy the one you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Potion Shop - you need this so Shop4 shows up[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Make sure Kenneth's Potion Shop is also installed.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Start the game and check Shop4.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. Works with the other potions from Kenneth's Potion Shop. You can add it in the middle of a save, no need to start a new game.[/b][/size]
